column1: # The fifth round of levers: the zerocheck constraint arithmetic.
# Machine idle, fib n=2,000,000 at a 4 MiB shard size, measured 2026-08-24 on an M4 Max.
# Both switches change generated shader source, so the first run after a flip pays a
# full shader recompile -- one such run took 108 s wall against ~11 s -- and is
# discarded rather than recorded. Every row below had a warm cache.
# The ZC_LAYOUT=on arm has two rows rather than three because its third run was the
# cold one; the arms overlap so completely that a third would not settle anything.
